propositions: Structured-output validation and recovery must execute through one Pydantic Agent operation with shared request budget, replacing split bespoke retry orchestration
Retry context must preserve complete failed response on proven fit and omit it entirely otherwise, never truncating authoritative input or stored history
Rebar deterministic extraction, fallback eligibility, terminal refusal, typed exhaustion, final-failure artifacts, and model provenance must be preserved across the Pydantic integration
Successful operations report complete Pydantic usage exactly once; fallback and downgrade candidates remain trace or journal events without competing usage counters
Bespoke structured-output retry loop removal is deferred pending compatibility suite pass and authorized Anthropic/Bedrock cache canaries
